circuitpython_stdout_note: CircuitPython 10.3.0's own answer, at the same ceiling this port ships (64). SEVEN of the eight lines are now identical to `stdout`, and to desktop MicroPython. Until 2026-09-09 three differed and this note blamed the deliberate biquad deviations; that was wrong on all three counts, and each had its own cause: (1) `lead` was the biquad deviation being applied on one target only -- audioif#77, resolved by holding synthio.Biquad to CircuitPython's Q15 on every target; (2) `bend` was the zero-crossing loudness gate reading the wrong voice slot on the CPython twin, whose note list compacts where CircuitPython's channel array does not -- fixed by giving each note the channel index it was admitted on; (3) part of the SAW waveform was the test-only ulab bridge rounding where real ulab truncates, in tests/support/ulab. REMAINING, and tracked as audioif#78: `bass` still differs on the CPython twin, in exactly one block -- the first after note_off, where the amp envelope enters release. The blocks either side are byte-identical, the modulated cutoff and Q agree to nine decimals, and MicroPython matches CircuitPython. Measured 2026-09-09.
